Work With Us: Work with us Are you looking for a rewarding and challenging opportunity to work with young learners in a vibrant and diverse environment? Do you have a passion for education and a desire to make a difference in the lives of students and teachers? If yes, then you might be the perfect candidate for an internship at Woodlands House School. As an intern at Woodlands House School, you will have the opportunity to learn from experienced and dedicated teachers, interact with enthusiastic and curious students, and contribute to the school’s mission and vision. You will also gain valuable skills and experience that will enhance your personal and professional development. How we work At Woodlands House School, we work as a team of professionals who share a common goal: to provide the best possible education for our students. We believe in fostering a culture of collaboration, creativity, and continous improvement. We value diversity, inclusion, and respect for all members of our community. We also strive to create a positive and supportive work environment where everyone can grow and thrive. Join The Team As an intern, you will be assigned to a specific department or grade level, depending on your interest and qualifications. You will work closely with your mentor teacher, who will guide you through your tasks and responsibilities. You will have the chance to observe different teaching methods and styles, assist in lesson planning and delivery, provide feedback and support to students, and engage in various co-curricular activities. What We Look For We are looking for interns who are passionate about education and eager to learn from our teachers. We expect our interns to have the following qualities: – Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in Education or a related field – Good command of English language (both spoken and written) – Positive attitude and willingness to learn new things – Sense of responsibility and professionalism – Respect for diversity and cultural sensitivity – Creativity and an ability to think outside the box – Flexibility and and ability to adapt to different situations – Love for children, love for learning and love for teaching How To Apply At WHS, we aim to make our hiring process smooth and clear, so we can truly appreciate your unique talents abilities that will help you excel in the role. If you have any questions or queries regarding the internship program, please feel free to contact us. We look forward to hearing from you soon! Internship If you are not sure about what role you would like to take, you are welcome to apply by mailing your resume to whs.shivpora@gmail.com Submit Resume
Director&#8217;s Note: History Chairman’s Desk Vice Chairperson’s Perspective Directors Note Administrator’s Note Supervisors Note Farid Singh | Viraj Singh Directors The idea of designing a curriculum that prepares students for the future seems unassailable. After all, education is not only for the present. The purpose of education on a global perspective is in shaping the student for tomorrow’s challenges in technological, economical, social, environmental, health, political, moral and other issues the nations are going to face as solution providers and leaders of tomorrow. Woodlands House School is dedicated to excellence in all the work that it does, with the aim of enabling our students to develop as rounded individuals who can thrive in an increasingly complex and uncertain world. Our core focus is delivering high quality academic programs that will enable students to achieve their intellectual potential and have greater choice in their lives beyond school, including access to the best colleges. We believe that Woodlands House offers an outstanding school experience, which our students will cherish for the rest of their lives.
Sports: School Calendar 2025 – 2026 Co-curricular Activities Sports Sports Sports are an integral part of our curriculum and help our children to grow holistically. The school is constantly striving to provide training and better opportunities in the field of sports, thus motivating the children to make meaningful contributions on the sports front. To keep the children accentuated with Nature and to teach them self-discipline, various inter house tournaments like basketball, cricket, volleyball, badminton, kho kho are organized every year. Other activities such as ‘cross country run’, ‘hiking’, ‘run for fun’ are also conducted during the course of the year. The school has a well-organized Physical Education Department, affiliated with Department of Youth Services and Sports, Government of J&K.
Co-curricular Activities: School Calendar 2025 – 2026 Co-curricular Activities Sports Co-curricular Activities We at Woodlands reflect the kaleidoscope of taking up adventures, creativity and positive approach for young minds. The school focuses on guiding the students to become well rounded in curricular as well as co-curricular activities by maintaining a close eye on their emotional, social and physical needs. To fulfill these needs the school has different clubs/societies to educate, enlighten and sensitize students about various issues.

History: History Chairman’s Desk Vice Chairperson’s Perspective Directors Note Administrator’s Note Supervisors Note Late. Mrs. Rup S.P. Singh | Late. Mr. S.P. Singh Founders Woodlands House School was established by our beloved Founder Principal Mrs Rup SP Singh in the year 1966 under the foothills of the world famous Takht-e-Sulaiman/Shankaracharya Temple. Initially the school started with a few students but her dedication, devotion and hard work attracted the people of J&K in general and that of Srinagar in particular. The institution began to progress and within no time the curve of the roll started going up. Her work was recognized by the then Chief Minister, Late Bakshi Gulam Mohammad and later on by Sheikh Mohammed Abdullah who encouraged her to start her junior wing at Shivpora, Srinagar which later was converted to the Girls Wing. Woodlands House School was the need of the hour as only a few English Medium Schools were functioning and a good number of students got enrolled in the school. Under her dynamic leadership our school moved forward in every sphere- academic, co-curricular and infrastructural. She was full of keen insight and a balance of best qualities of head and heart. We are really proud of her leadership and guidance. Her role as a competent head of the prestigious institution is recognized equally by students and noble citizens of the state. She had adream of an ideal institution which serves as a corrective measure for students and an ameliorative factor for the society which she truly achieved during her tenure. She wished that students should be able to imbibe best social and moral values during their education in the school and after completion of their education they would serve as role models in the society. The result of which is that our students excel in different fields and bring laurels of success to the institution. Unfortunately our Founder Principal parted with us in the year 1995 and her son, Mr. Riki Singh, the Chairman/Principal of the school had to shoulder the responsibility of running and managing the school as per the expectations of the people. Following the footprints of our founder he leaves no stone unturned to make this institution a success.

Admission Requirements: Admission Requirements Admission Enquiry Admission Children are admitted during the month of October each year. A child will not be admitted without an Interview/Test. A student who has attended a recognized school cannot be admitted without a school leaving/birth certificate from the school last attended. Admission is open to children of two to five years. Requirements 1. Birth Certificate 2. Two passport sized photographs of the child & one with both the parents 3. Proof of up-to date immunization. 4. Complete physical examination performed anytime within six months. 5. Physical presence of the child.
Curriculum: Curriculum Curriculum We at Woodlands House School recognize that all students are uniquely talented. With our exceptionally supportive infrastructure students relish the opportunity to realize their individual potential to the full. Learning at Woodlands House is highly student-centered, engaging and enquiry–based. Through a broad range of experiences in and beyond school, students become confident, optimistic, compassionate young adults, ready to find their place in the world. Woodlands House School has acquired the reputation of becoming synonymous with academic excellence. Every child is given an opportunity to pursue first class education regardless of any personal factor. The school has taken various steps to connect its class rooms to high level schools to educate and empower every student. We at Woodlands aim to provide a good balance of captivating context, offering new ideas, fresh perspectives and a visual treat through images.
